checkout.name: Hybrid Self-Checkout
highlights: Built a Python pipeline combining YOLOv8/OpenCV product detection, USB barcode input and MySQL product/transaction data.
Repository-reported evaluation: 77.4% precision and 72.0% recall after 50 epochs; tested visual verification challenges including occlusion and similar packaging.

gesture.name: Gesture Recognition / Touchless Reader
highlights: Converted MediaPipe hand landmarks into 71-dimensional features and a 100-tree Random Forest for browser inference in JavaScript.
Implemented gesture navigation with cooldowns and virtual controls. Reported 98.6% cross-validation accuracy; not a real-world user accuracy measurement.

hermes.name: Hermes / Multi-Model Agent Orchestration
highlights: Built a documented Python/Termux experiment with multi-model consensus routing, telemetry, watchdog recovery and post-mortem analysis on mobile hardware.
Separated serving and gateway processes and used telemetry to review model disagreement and unavailable-provider behaviour.

livestock.name: IoT Livestock Weight Tracking
highlights: Contributed to a team weighing/monitoring platform using Arduino, HX711 load-cell amplifiers, C/C++ signal filtering and telemetry dashboards.
Team awarded Third Place at INOTEK 2025 (Series 1), 15 January 2025, for Development of Livestock Weight Tracking System Based on IoT.

smc-crows.name: SMC Crows / Android Release Engineering
highlights: Contributed to the SMC Crows community through Android compatibility investigation, release packaging, device testing and installation and account recovery guidance.
Community distribution recorded 29,594 download requests across all release and setup versions as of 22 October 2026. Counts include retries.

arcade.name: Mini Arcade / Interactive Web Applications
highlights: Built a React/TypeScript arcade with minimax-based Tic Tac Toe, penalty-shootout and memory-game interactions, styled with Tailwind CSS.
Explored game-state transitions, decision logic and touch/desktop interaction through a publicly accessible browser application.
